findings.title: Migration crashes with IndexError when `embed_category` is not set and does not normalize host values
findings.body: `execute(...)` returns a `PG::Result` whose `[0]` accessor raises `IndexError: Index 0 is out of range` whenever the query returns 0 rows. On any database where the `embed_category` site setting was never stored or does not match an existing category name, `execute(...)[0]['id']` will fail and abort the migration (the same risk applies to line 15 if `uncategorized_category_id` is absent from `site_settings`). In addition, line 25 inserts raw `h` values directly with string interpolation without stripping `http(s)://` prefixes or `/...` paths the way `EmbeddableHost`'s `before_validation` hook does, so previously valid `embeddable_hosts` entries containing a scheme or path will not match `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` after migration.

findings.title: `before_validation` raises `NoMethodError` when `host` is nil and `record_for_host` fails on uppercase or port-qualified hosts
findings.body: In `before_validation`, `self.host.sub!` is called unconditionally, which raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'sub!' for nil:NilClass` if `EmbeddableHost.new` is validated with a `nil` host. Also, in `self.record_for_host(host)` (lines 14-17), `uri.host` is not downcased before `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first`, so any referer URL with uppercase characters in the hostname will fail to match, and although the format validation on line 2 explicitly allows a port (`(:[0-9]{1,5})?`), `uri.host` strips the port, so a stored host with a port will never be matched by `record_for_host`.

findings.title: Contents of `category_fabricator.rb` and `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` are swapped
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` was replaced with `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)` while the category fabricators (`:category`, `:diff_category`, `:happy_category`, `:private_category`) were placed in `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb`. The two files have their contents transposed.

findings.title: Saving a new host with default category sets `host.category` to `undefined`
findings.body: When a new `embeddable-host` row is added, `categoryId` on the component starts as `null`. On save, the server defaults a blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` and returns it in the payload, which updates `host.category_id`. However, the `.then()` callback immediately runs `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` using the component's `null` `categoryId` instead of `host.get('category_id')` (or initializing `categoryId` to the uncategorized category id), leaving `host.category` as `undefined` in the UI until the page is reloaded.
